facts.business: Omkar Overseas Limited is a listed company with no revenue from operations during FY2026, indicating it may be a shell or non-operating entity.

auditor.name: M/s. N.S. Nanavati & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The company has not generated any revenue from operations during the year ended March 31, 2026, incurred a loss of Rs. 17.03 lakh, has negative net worth of Rs. 37.88 lakh, negative operating cash flows of Rs. 15.67 lakh, cash and cash equivalents of Rs. 4.68 lakh against borrowings of Rs. 39.10 lakh, and certain trade payables outstanding for earlier periods. Management has proposed a capital reduction under Section 230 read with Section 66 of the Companies Act, 2013, subject to member and NCLT approval.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to no revenue from operations, accumulated losses, negative net worth, and negative operating cash flows
Dependence on successful implementation of proposed capital reduction scheme subject to NCLT approval
Outstanding trade payables from earlier periods
High borrowings relative to cash and cash equivalents
